aaaaaaaaroot00000000000000000000.title: Indonesian banks deliver superior risk-adjusted returns into H2 2026
aaaaaaaaroot00000000000000000000.body: Top-down thesis: BI policy easing in H2 2026 expands banking-sector NIM by 25-40bp while loan growth re-accelerates with consumer demand. Combined effect supports double-digit EPS growth across top-4 banks at undemanding valuation multiples.

aaaaaaaamacsub100000000000000000.title: BI cuts policy rate by 75bp in H2 2026, expanding banking-sector NIM 25-40bp
aaaaaaaamacsub100000000000000000.body: Rate cycle: Bank Indonesia delivers cumulative 75bp policy rate cut between July and December 2026 as inflation prints converge to the 2.5-3.5% target band. Liability re-pricing lags asset-side pass-through, lifting NIM in the 3-6 month window.

aaaaaaaamacsub200000000000000000.title: Indonesian consumer-driven loan demand re-accelerates in 2026
aaaaaaaamacsub200000000000000000.body: Loan growth: consumer credit accelerates from low-double-digit to mid-teens YoY by Q3 2026 as election-cycle fiscal stimulus, recovering middle-class real wages, and easier rates re-open mortgage and auto-loan demand.

aaaaaaaamacassump000000000000000.title: BI maintains its inflation-targeting framework through 2027
aaaaaaaamacassump000000000000000.body: Base-case assumption: Bank Indonesia continues to operate within its inflation-targeting framework rather than shifting toward FX-defense or growth-targeting. Violation likely triggers IDR weakness and policy-rate volatility that breaks the rate-cut path central to the thesis.
aaaaaaaamacassump000000000000000.if_violated: Rate-cut path becomes unpredictable; NIM thesis collapses; IDR risks 5-10% downside.

aaaaaaaamacques00000000000000000.title: What is BI 7-day reverse repo trajectory through Q4 2026 implied by IndoGB curve?
aaaaaaaamacques00000000000000000.body: Specific factual question: extract the policy-rate path priced into the IndoGB curve as of latest pricing. Resolution requires Refinitiv or Bloomberg curve pull plus standard implied-policy-rate decomposition.

aaaaaaaacatalyst1000000000000000.title: Bank Indonesia September 2026 RDG (Board of Governors meeting)
aaaaaaaacatalyst1000000000000000.body: Scheduled BI policy meeting. Outcome (cut size and forward guidance) directly resolves the H2 2026 rate-path sub-thesis.
aaaaaaaacatalyst1000000000000000.expected_impact: 25-50bp cut likely; sets pace for Oct/Nov/Dec meetings.

aaaaaaaaindsub100000000000000000.title: Banking-sector NIM expands from 5.1% to 5.4% by Q4 2026
aaaaaaaaindsub100000000000000000.body: Industry-level NIM: weighted top-4 NIM rises ~30bp as BI cuts pass through to deposit costs faster than asset yields adjust. Competitive intensity in CASA gathering caps expansion at the upper end.

aaaaaaaaindmetric000000000000000.title: Indonesian banking sector quarterly NIM (top-4 weighted)
aaaaaaaaindmetric000000000000000.body: Track quarterly NIM disclosed in BBCA, BMRI, BBRI, BBNI earnings. Sum-of-RWA-weighted to keep cross-cycle comparison stable.

aaaaaaaaindsub200000000000000000.title: Asset-quality stable: NPL ratio held below 2.5% through 2026
aaaaaaaaindsub200000000000000000.body: Industry NPL: writebacks and lower restructured-loan re-rolls keep the sector NPL ratio below the 2.5% threshold that historically triggers risk-off in Indonesian financials.

aaaaaaaaindevidence0000000000000.title: Latest broker NIM forecasts for top-4 Indonesian banks (Q3 / Q4 2026)
aaaaaaaaindevidence0000000000000.body: Pull most recent broker forecasts (Mandiri Sekuritas, BCA Sekuritas, foreign houses) for BBCA / BMRI / BBRI / BBNI NIM by quarter. Cross-check against in-house NIM model.

aaaaaaaaeqbbca000000000000000000.title: BBCA: superior CASA franchise compounds NIM tailwind into 18-22% EPS CAGR
aaaaaaaaeqbbca000000000000000000.body: Single-name view: BBCA leverages best-in-sector ~70% CASA mix to capture more of the rate-cut transmission. Combined with low-teens loan growth, drives 18-22% EPS CAGR over 12-24M against current 22x forward P/E.

aaaaaaaaeqbbri000000000000000000.title: BBRI: micro-segment loan growth re-accelerates as Kupedes book turns
aaaaaaaaeqbbri000000000000000000.body: Single-name view: BBRI rural-micro Kupedes book exits its 2024-2025 NPL clean-up cycle in H1 2026, returning to 12-15% loan growth and re-rating off depressed multiples.
